examples.text: Allow things to settle with time.
examples.translation: 让事情随着时间慢慢平息下来。
examples.speechText: Allow things to settle with time.

examples.text: Women get emotional support through a network of friends（friend的复数形式） and family.
examples.translation: 女性通过朋友和家人组成的关系网获得情感支持。
examples.speechText: Women get emotional support through a network of friends and family.

examples.text: The pressure we put on ourselves is making sleep worse, she said.
examples.translation: 她说，我们给自己施加的压力正在让睡眠变得更差。
examples.speechText: The pressure we put on ourselves is making sleep worse, she said.

examples.translation: 后来，出现了意想不到的事情。

examples.text: Families（family的复数形式）, too, are simpler today.
examples.translation: 如今，家庭结构也更加简单了。

examples.text: Boris Worm is an ocean biologist at Canada's Dalhousie University.
examples.translation: Boris Worm是加拿大达尔豪斯大学的一位海洋生物学家。
examples.speechText: Boris Worm is an ocean biologist at Canada's Dalhousie University.

examples.text: Simple acts like covering your nose and mouth with a tissue when you cough or sneeze and using your elbow if you don’t have a tissue can be effective in preventing the spread of bacteria.
examples.translation: 一些简单的做法就能有效防止细菌传播，比如咳嗽或打喷嚏时用纸巾遮住口鼻，没有纸巾时则用肘部遮挡。
examples.speechText: Simple acts like covering your nose and mouth with a tissue when you cough or sneeze and using your elbow if you don’t have a tissue can be effective in preventing the spread of bacteria.

examples.text: Applying mulch makes the garden look neat and clean.
examples.translation: 铺设覆盖物能让花园看起来整洁干净。
examples.speechText: Applying mulch makes the garden look neat and clean.

examples.text: These results must be accurate, because all the calculations have been done by an electronic computer.
examples.translation: 这些结果一定是准确的，因为所有计算都是由电子计算机完成的。
examples.speechText: These results must be accurate, because all the calculations have been done by an electronic computer.

examples.text: The best collectors survived long cold winters or seasons without rain.
examples.translation: 最善于采集的人熬过了漫长寒冷的冬季或没有雨水的季节。
examples.speechText: The best collectors survived long cold winters or seasons without rain.

examples.text: Your relationship with yourself will last your whole lifetime, so you should regard yourself as your best friend.
examples.translation: 你与自己的关系将持续一生，因此应该把自己当作最好的朋友。
examples.speechText: Your relationship with yourself will last your whole lifetime, so you should regard yourself as your best friend.

examples.text: When you are in anger, before reacting, just sit quietly, close your eyes（eye的复数形式） and start breathing deeply.
examples.translation: 生气时，先别急着作出反应，静静坐下，闭上眼睛，开始深呼吸。
examples.speechText: When you are in anger, before reacting, just sit quietly, close your eyes and start breathing deeply.

examples.text: In 1870, Mark Twain married（marry的过去式） Olivia Langdon.
examples.speechText: In 1870, Mark Twain married Olivia Langdon.

examples.text: What the author wants to express in the book is the love and care for the family.
examples.translation: 作者在这本书中想表达的是对家人的爱与关怀。
examples.speechText: What the author wants to express in the book is the love and care for the family.

examples.text: Every region has its own special food, which carries the history and customs（custom的复数形式） of the place.
examples.translation: 每个地区都有自己独特的食物，其中承载着当地的历史和风俗。
examples.speechText: Every region has its own special food, which carries the history and customs of the place.
